title: work-unit.json (Milestone manifest, runs/milestone-<slug>/work-unit.json)
description: CIR-01/CIR-23 (M3.2): a Milestone is N ROADMAP.md items grouped under one branch/worktree/PR/HITL (PAR-WU-MILESTONE, PAR-MILESTONE-SINGLE-CIRCUIT). `items` is the TEMPLATE v2.0.5-compatible flat list (workunit-lib.ps1's Write-WorkUnitManifest, schemaVersion 1). `tasks`, when present, adds an explicit dependency DAG over those same items (PAR-TASK-DAG) -- optional because a Milestone with no stated order is still valid (items may run in any order).

items.description: Feature/Maintenance slugs this Milestone groups, same shape as Get-WorkUnitInfo -Mode Feature/Maintenance.

tasks.description: Optional explicit DAG over `items`. When present, every item must appear in exactly one task and every dependsOn must reference another task's id.
